3. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary

4. Logic: Identify the parent compound by chembl_id 'CHEMBL493620'. Include the parent and all child salt forms via molecule_hierarchy (parent_molregno). Join to compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join to compound_records and docs for provenance (compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi). Join to activities and assays for assay_description and activity metrics. Filter for standard_type 'IC50'. Join to target_dictionary and filter for target chembl_id 'CHEMBL612557' (RAW264.7). Sort by all output columns.
